card.text: Explore Desdemona, an inner moon of Uranus, through its measured shape.

introduction.text: Desdemona is an elongated member of Uranus’s tightly packed inner moon system, discovered in Voyager 2 images in 1986.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: A 90 × 54 × 54 km shape estimate. Two axes are assumed equal; gray grid: no imagery, not observed terrain.
